value.rationale: Exact sharp leading operator norm for a canonical continuous least-squares projector on half-spheres, a uniform latitude-dependent local amplification law, and an iff classification of asymptotic worst-case evaluation points. Half-space conditioning changes the Gaussian limit and creates a strict polar location selection, a structural phenomenon not implied by generic finite-dimensional bounds.
